lines.text: τροπικοῖς δὲ δημοσίᾳ, ἐν δισώμοις μετὰ πολλῶν· καὶ Ἑρμῆς μὲν

lines.en: the betrayer will escape notice, but if oriental he will not escape notice. Being in another

lines.en: they signify for them, but being depressed or subtracting, destruction

lines.text: τειχῶν μὲν ἢ ἐγγαίων, ὅταν Κρόνος περιέχων κακῶται, μηχανημάτων
lines.en: of walls or earthworks, when Kronos enclosing is afflicted, of siege engines

lines.en: when the Moon, of allies, when Zeus, of the populace, when Helios. The

lines.en: other or if they are in a common sign, the enemies will be reconciled.

lines.text: ὑπὸ δὲ κακοποιῶν ἐπὶ λύμῃ· τῶν δ’ ἐπαναφορῶν οἱ δεσπόται εἰ

summary.headline: Astrology of Siege Warfare
summary.text: Astrological judgments about war, betrayal, attackers, besieged parties, fortresses, siege engines, temples, allies, populace, and reconciliation. The text assigns these matters to houses, angles, planets, configurations, benefics and malefics, and introduces “Another consideration concerning war.”
